result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially cut-off restaurant card in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' — the full name is cut off due to the card being partially outside the viewport. This is expected for a carousel, but the text truncation mid-word without an ellipsis looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis and overflow: hidden to restaurant name labels within carousel cards so truncated names end gracefully with '...' instead of being cut mid-word.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cropped at the bottom of the screen without any visual affordance (e.g., fade or shadow) indicating more content is available below.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or a subtle visual cue at the bottom of the scrollable content area to indicate that more items are available below the visible area, improving discoverability.
